notes: Historical EBIT is mapped to Vulcan’s “Operating earnings” line from the Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income; historical D&A maps to “Depreciation, depletion, accretion and amortization”; capex maps to “Purchases of property, plant & equipment.” ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1396009/000162828026009546/vmc-20251231.htm))

NWC calculation definition (annual, balance-sheet based): NWC = (Total current assets − cash & restricted cash − assets held for sale) − (Total current liabilities − current maturities of long-term debt − liabilities held for sale). This excludes discontinued/divestiture-related items where balance sheet labels exist; expect variability across years with transaction activity. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1396009/000162828026009546/vmc-20251231.htm))

Tax rate in DCF set to 0.22 based on effective tax rate range/level disclosed and guided (22–23% outlook; ~22.1% effective). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1396009/000162828026009546/vmc-20251231.htm))
WACC (0.075 base) is a constructed modeling assumption (not explicitly disclosed in filings); scenario WACC changes reflect only bull/bear regime shifts. Gap: no direct WACC published by the company.

NOL balance (tax loss carryforward $ amount) is not disclosed as a single consolidated dollar figure in an immediately usable form; set to null. Utilization percent is set to 0.80 per provided pipeline default; deferred-tax components related to NOL carryforwards are discussed in the 10-K. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1396009/000162828026009546/vmc-20251231.htm))

catalysts: Sustained improvement in freight-adjusted price and shipments (management’s 2026 outlook targets) leading to upside to base-case operating earnings. ([prnewswire.com](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vulcan-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-302689055.html?utm_source=openai))

Positive cycle inflection from public infrastructure spending and improving private nonresidential activity translating into volume growth beyond the base-case trajectory. ([prnewswire.com](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vulcan-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-302689055.html?utm_source=openai))

Further evidence of margin resilience through cost control and disciplined selling/operating execution (“Vulcan Way”). ([prnewswire.com](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vulcan-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-302689055.html?utm_source=openai))
company_overview: Vulcan is a leading producer of construction aggregates with related materials businesses (as described in its SEC filings and investor communications). ([prnewswire.com](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vulcan-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-302689055.html?utm_source=openai))

Generates earnings largely through aggregates pricing/shipments and operating discipline, with depreciation driving a meaningful D&A profile in the cash flow statement. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1396009/000162828026009546/vmc-20251231.htm))

Uses a disciplined capital allocation framework supported by recurring maintenance and growth capital spending. ([prnewswire.com](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vulcan-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-302689055.html?utm_source=openai))
current_context: Management guided to 2026 Adjusted EBITDA of $2.4B to $2.6B, citing strength in public construction activity and improving private nonresidential opportunities. ([prnewswire.com](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vulcan-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-302689055.html?utm_source=openai))

Outlook assumptions include shipments up 1–3% and freight-adjusted price improvement of 4–6%, with capital spending of $750M to $800M and depreciation/depletion/accretion/amortization near $700M. ([prnewswire.com](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vulcan-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-302689055.html?utm_source=openai))

Company reiterated an effective tax rate of 22–23% and expects continued improvement in aggregates unit profitability. ([prnewswire.com](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vulcan-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-302689055.html?utm_source=openai))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth assumes continued (mid-single-digit) demand support translating into stable pricing/shipments consistent with 2026 outlook parameters (1–3% shipments; 4–6% price). ([prnewswire.com](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vulcan-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-302689055.html?utm_source=openai))

Base-case EBIT margin expansion is modest versus 2024–2025 given the company’s operating earnings sensitivity to pricing and cost discipline. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1396009/000162828026009546/vmc-20251231.htm))

Reinvestment intensity (capex as % of sales) is set consistent with management’s $750M–$800M 2026 capital spending guidance, supporting asset base and throughput. ([prnewswire.com](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vulcan-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-302689055.html?utm_source=openai))

Working-capital utilization is normalized away from the 2024 acquisition/disposition effects using a stable NWC % of sales assumption in the base case. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1396009/000162828026009546/vmc-20251231.htm))
key_risks: Construction demand cyclicality and potential weakness in residential and/or nonresidential construction reducing volumes and margin leverage. ([prnewswire.com](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vulcan-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-302689055.html?utm_source=openai))

Working-capital swings and cost inflation (fuel/energy, labor, freight) that could pressure EBIT margin versus base case. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1396009/000162828026009546/vmc-20251231.htm))

International/legal/tax uncertainties (e.g., Mexico operations and deferred tax/NOL realizability) affecting effective tax rate and cash flows. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1396009/000162828026009546/vmc-20251231.htm))

presentation.subtitle: VMC DCF input pack — base-case drivers calibrated to 2025 results and 2026 outlook
valuation_summary: DCF base-case driver set (growth, margins, D&A, capex, NWC) is calibrated to observed 2023–2025 financial structure from Vulcan’s annual reporting and to 2026 guidance touchpoints (capex, D&A, tax rate). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1396009/000162828026009546/vmc-20251231.htm))

Terminal valuation uses an exit-multiple framework on EBITDA with a growth rate reflecting mature-cycle economics rather than short-term cycle extremes. ([prnewswire.com](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/vulcan-reports-fourth-quarter-and-full-year-2025-results-302689055.html?utm_source=openai))

Comps anchor is provided using EV-to-forward revenue/EBITDA and forward P/E proxies from a consistent source (GuruFocus) to frame a reasonable range for terminal/exit assumptions. ([gurufocus.com](https://www.gurufocus.com/stock/MLM/summary?utm_source=openai))
